statement: Median per-capita disposable income growth < mean growth in 2027 annual data (national statistics office, e.g. Bloc B NBS; annual release)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable at the timeline start. No household-income release fell inside the window; the latest available figures (Q1-Q3 2022, published 2022-10-25) showed Bloc B median per-capita disposable income growing 5.1% vs 5.3% for the mean (median below mean), with the median at 84.2% of the mean. Full-year 2022 data were published in January 2023 and are excluded.

items.summary: Bloc B statistics office, first three quarters of 2022: mean per-capita disposable income 27,650 yuan (+5.3% nominal, +3.2% real); median 23,277 yuan (+5.1%), 84.2% of the mean. Median growth below mean growth; urban median growth equal to urban mean (4.3%), rural median below rural mean (5.9% vs 6.4%).
items.detail: Bloc B National Bureau of Statistics, 'Households' Income and Consumption Expenditure in the First Three Quarters of 2022', 2022-10-25 (verified via web_extract this run). Pre-window baseline: the latest such release available during the window.

items.summary: No Bloc A equivalent median-vs-mean disposable income series is set up for this indicator, and no Bloc B household-income release was published inside the window (full-year 2022 data appeared in January 2023).
items.detail: Indicator source names one series per leading jurisdiction; only the NBS series is populated in this backfill. Reference: NBS Q1-Q3 2022 release (verified via web_extract this run).
